pack.jurisdiction: International voluntary use; published by NIST (United States)
coverage: all six Functions and 22 current Categories
profile-scoped assessment against an organisation-selected Target Profile
known_gaps: The pack does not choose an organisation's Current or Target Profile.
Implementation Tiers, implementation examples and informative references require separate profile material.
Outcome achievement remains evidence-based and organisation-specific; the pack does not prescribe one implementation method.
pack.notice: NIST CSF 2.0 is voluntary. Findings describe gaps against selected outcomes and do not establish legal non-compliance or certification.
